column3: Close to the Greek; NKJV has the order “Jesus Christ,” where the Greek here reads “Christ Jesus.”
Close to the Greek; NKJV moves “Jesus Christ our Lord” up from the end of verse 4 to verse 3.
Close to the Greek; “Jesus Christ our Lord,” which closes this verse in Greek, appears in verse 3 in NKJV.
NKJV has “the gospel of Christ,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the gospel.”
NKJV includes “sexual immorality,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
